intro: Plan how to cut your Parts out of your Stock with the least Waste.

settings.defaultHint: Leave empty to use the default, {{ value }}.

error.unreadable: That isn't a length. Try 3 mm, 1/8" or 2 1/2".

stock.title: Stock
stock.description: The lengths you can cut from. For example 2400, 94 1/2" or 2400 mm; without a unit, numbers use your preferred Unit System.

quantity.label: Quantity
quantity.hint: Empty means as many as needed.

cutList.title: Cut List
cutList.description: The Parts you need, for example 720, 28 3/8" or 720 mm long. A name is optional; it helps you tell Parts apart in the Cutting Plan.

errors.lengthUnreadable: That length can't be read. Try something like 2400, 94 1/2" or 2400 mm.
errors.lengthNotPositive: A length must be greater than zero.
errors.quantityNotPositiveInteger: The quantity must be a whole number greater than zero, or empty for as many as needed.
errors.partQuantityNotPositiveInteger: The quantity must be a whole number greater than zero.

jobSettings.title: Job settings
jobSettings.description: Prefilled from your defaults. Changes here apply only to this job.

trim.label: Trim at each end
trim.hint: Cut off both ends of every Stock before placing Parts.

errors.empty: Enter a length, or 0 for none.
errors.unreadable: That length can't be read. Try something like 5 mm, 1/8" or 0.
errors.negative: A length can't be negative. Use 0 or more.

strategy.label: Strategy
strategy.hint: Uses as few Stock as possible, then the least total Stock length, then keeps the longest Offcuts.

generate.failed: The Cutting Plan could not be built. Try again.
generate.placeholder: Your Cutting Plan appears here once you generate it.

blocked.invalidFields: Fix the fields marked above to generate the Cutting Plan.
blocked.incompleteEntries: Fill in the length of every Stock and the length and quantity of every Part, or remove the ones you don't need.
blocked.missingEntries: Add at least one Stock and one Part to generate the Cutting Plan.

plan.title: Cutting Plan

waste.label: Waste
waste.hint: Leftover Waste, Trim and Kerf added up.

plan.settingsUsed: Kerf {{ kerf }} · Trim {{ trim }} at each end · Minimum Offcut Length {{ minimumOffcutLength }} · Strategy: {{ strategy }}

unplaced.title: Unplaced Parts ({{ count }})
unplaced.description: These Parts are missing from the Cutting Plan. The layouts below cover every other Part.
unplaced.tooLong: Longer than the usable length of every Stock ({{ length }} at most). Add longer Stock.
unplaced.insufficientStock: Not enough Stock: the limited Stock that fits is used up, and no unlimited Stock fits. Add more Stock.

layouts.title: Layouts
layouts.leftoverNone: None, the Parts use the whole Stock
